$schema_note: Deterministic recolour + emissive-overlay rule for the Hive World Verdant Strain. Consumed by scripts/generate_hive_strain_textures.py and asserted by scripts/validate_hive_strain_assets.py. Authority: docs/HIVE_WORLD_VERDANT_STRAIN.md section 5-6. No randomness anywhere in this file or its consumers.

source.recolour_scope: every .png under the texture roots, recursively, including eyes/ emissive sub-layers
source.excluded_reason: 1-4 px utility / non-creature sheets with no mycelial content; copied through unchanged so the parallel tree stays complete

output.note: build/ is gitignored (**/build/). These derivatives are NOT committed pending the Spore author's permission - see docs/HIVE_WORLD_VERDANT_STRAIN.md section 11.

recolour.description: A pixel is remapped only if it falls in the mycelial band. Remapped pixels are replaced by a 3-stop deep-to-bright green ramp indexed by the source pixel's HSV value. All other pixels - bone, teeth, metal, leather, near-black, already-cool hues, and fully transparent pixels - are copied byte-identically.

mycelial_band.comment: Saturated crimson/red/magenta-pink only. The saturation floor deliberately spares the desaturated pinkish-grey infected flesh so the creature still reads as flesh; the green identity comes from the mycelial growth plus the emissive overlay.

green_ramp.interpolation: linear in 8-bit sRGB between the two bracketing stops
green_ramp.hue_envelope_comment: validator check 4: every remapped output pixel must have hue within this range

recolour.untouched_guarantee: validator check 4: for every output texture, the set of pixels whose source is outside mycelial_band must be byte-identical to source

overlay.purpose: Emissive bright-green spore / mycelium speckle + faint glow over the remapped mycelial areas. Rendered later by the companion mod with RenderType.entityTranslucentEmissive.

determinism.method: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister) with a fixed integer seed - reproducible across runs, machines, and Python builds. No wall-clock, no os RNG.
determinism.draw_order: growth_glow (from band mask), then spore_speckle sampling, then spore_core sampling; core writes over speckle
determinism.sampling: let OPAQUE be the row-major indices of every source texel with alpha != 0. draw floor(len(OPAQUE) / period) picks via OPAQUE[rng.randrange(len(OPAQUE))]; pixel = (i % w, i // w). Restricting to opaque texels keeps emissive dots on the drawn model only. speckle draws first, then core continues the same rng stream.

layers.name: growth_glow
layers.rule: where the source pixel was inside mycelial_band, write ARGB 0x3341ff52

layers.name: spore_core
layers.rule: floor(w*h/211) sampled pixels get ARGB 0xc0b6ffa0 (written after, overriding speckle)

budget.growth_glow_coverage: <= the mycelial-band pixel fraction (glow is a subset of the recoloured area; it may legitimately cover a whole heavily-infested texture)
budget.comment: validator check 5 - the faint alpha-0x33 glow wash is bounded by the band mask (already checked by check 4); only the bright speckle + core dots are capped so they stay sparse. period 23 + period 211 => ~4.8% expected, 0.09 leaves RNG margin.

hit_points.note: Documented here for traceability; applied by runtime code (deferred), not by these scripts. See docs/HIVE_WORLD_VERDANT_STRAIN.md section 7.
